Planner.SeedIntent: Shawn compared the older, already-working PMCR-O AI Agent Company marketplace (17 granular one-role-per-plugin entries, each showing real skill counts) against the newly-fixed PMCR-O-Marketplace and reported the consolidated bundle plugins (pmcro-csuite, pmcro-engine) showing 'nothing inside' in the Claude directory browse, despite marketplace.json now being valid.
Planner.ProposedAction: Sweep every plugin.json in plugins/ (recursively, both .claude-plugin and .codex-plugin twins) for the BOM bug already diagnosed twice before in this repo's history (marketplace.json, pmcro-csuite/plugin.json). Fix any found, verify skill subfolders actually exist on disk for the affected plugins, then re-sweep to confirm zero remaining BOM files.
SuccessCriteria: Every plugin.json in the repo parses as valid JSON with no BOM
pmcro-csuite and pmcro-engine skill folders confirmed to exist on disk with real SKILL.md content, not just registered names
Root-cause identified for why these two specific plugins showed empty vs. the other two that didn't

Maker.ActionSummary: Read pmcro-csuite/.claude-plugin/plugin.json directly and saw a leading BOM artifact before the opening brace, plus PowerShell-ConvertTo-Json-style double-space formatting ('"description":  "..."') indicating it was last written by a PowerShell Set-Content/Out-File call using default (BOM-including) UTF-8 encoding. Wrote a recursive PowerShell sweep script checking byte[0..2] for EF BB BF across all plugin.json files under plugins/. Found pmcro-csuite/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and pmcro-engine/.claude-plugin/plugin.json both BOM'd; pmcro-legacy and pmcro-specialty were already clean. Confirmed via list_directory that both plugins' skill subfolders (9 for csuite: ceo/cfo/chief-of-staff/chro/clo/cmo/coo/cro/cto; 5 for engine: checker/maker/orchestrator/planner/reflector) exist on disk with real content -- the BOM was the only defect, not missing files. Rewrote both plugin.json files clean via Desktop Commander:write_file (confirmed BOM-free by this tool in prior cycle). Re-ran the sweep across all 40 plugin.json files (20 plugins x 2 manifest twins) -- zero BOM remaining.

GroundTruth.VerificationMethod: Recursive PowerShell script via Desktop Commander:start_process: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter plugin.json, byte[0..2] BOM check + ConvertFrom-Json parse on each
GroundTruth.Evidence: Full sweep output: all 40 plugin.json files (dotnet + dotnet-* x2 manifests each, pmcro-csuite/engine/legacy/specialty x2 manifests each) report BOM=False ParsesOK=True after the fix. Before the fix, exactly 2 of 40 had BOM=True: pmcro-csuite/.claude-plugin and pmcro-engine/.claude-plugin -- both now fixed.

Checker.Rationale: Root cause matches Shawn's exact symptom report: the 2 plugins he saw as empty in the directory browse are precisely the 2 files that had a BOM, and the other 2 that displayed fine (pmcro-legacy, pmcro-specialty) were the 2 that were already clean. Skill content was never missing -- only the manifest's parseability was broken.
CriteriaEvaluated: All 40 plugin.json files parse clean, zero BOM -- confirmed
pmcro-csuite (9 skills) and pmcro-engine (5 skills) skill folders confirmed present with real content on disk -- confirmed
Root cause isolated to BOM-corrupted .claude-plugin/plugin.json on exactly the 2 plugins Shawn reported as empty -- confirmed

Reflector.Rationale: This is the third confirmed instance of the same BOM defect in this repo (marketplace.json, then pmcro-csuite/plugin.json, now also pmcro-engine/plugin.json), all traceable to a PowerShell script somewhere in the toolchain writing JSON via a cmdlet that defaults to UTF-8-with-BOM (e.g. ConvertTo-Json | Out-File / Set-Content without -Encoding utf8NoBOM). plugin-creator's own SKILL.md already flags this pattern informally but no EarnedConstraint exists yet. Crystallizing one now since three recurrences in one repo is a real pattern, not a one-off.

Baton.NextSeedIntent: Audit any PowerShell scripts in this repo's tooling (eng/, .github/ workflows, any scaffold scripts referenced by skill-creator or plugin-creator) for ConvertTo-Json | Out-File / Set-Content calls missing -Encoding utf8NoBOM, and fix at the source so this stops recurring per-file. Commit and push these 2 BOM fixes.

EarnedConstraint.Statement: Any tool or script in this repo that writes plugin.json, marketplace.json, or other Claude Code manifest JSON via PowerShell MUST explicitly use -Encoding utf8NoBOM (or equivalent BOM-free UTF-8 write). PowerShell's default Out-File/Set-Content/ConvertTo-Json-pipe encoding on Windows writes a UTF-8 BOM, which silently breaks Claude Code's plugin/marketplace JSON parser with no useful error -- confirmed 3 times in this repo (marketplace.json, pmcro-csuite/plugin.json, pmcro-engine/plugin.json). Always verify with a byte-level read of the first 3 bytes (reject EF BB BF) before handing a written manifest back as complete.
